chunks: Ahmad ibn Idris from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutaibah from al-Fadl ibn Shazan from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ammar ibn Marwan from al-Munakhal ibn Jamil from Jabir al-Ju'fi from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The Mahdi is a man from the progeny of Fatima, and he is a man of wheaten complexion.
ai.seo_question: What are the physical characteristics of the Mahdi according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* affirms the Mahdi’s lineage from the Prophet’s daughter Fatima al-Zahra, a key criterion in Shia eschatology. The description of him as 'Adam' (wheat-colored) highlights his distinct physical appearance, linking his identity to the broader prophetic tradition while emphasizing his human nature.
